hints.title: Minimal Palindrome Sufficiency
hints.text: Any palindrome of length greater than k + 1 contains a strictly smaller centered sub-palindrome of length either k or k + 1.

hints.title: Length Bounds Restriction
hints.text: It is sufficient to only search for palindromes of length exactly k and length exactly k + 1.

hints.title: Greedy Scheduling
hints.text: Iterate from left to right. When a valid palindrome ending at i of length k or k + 1 is found that does not overlap with the previous selection, greedily select it.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Palindrome Selection Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing palindromes of length k and k + 1 at each index takes O(k) substring checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all possible palindrome lengths >= k produces quadratic interval sets and requires full dynamic interval scheduling.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond input string slices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that minimal palindromes of length k or k + 1 dominate longer ones and applies greedy interval scheduling.
